_comment: Stable GAME-STATE -> animation-key mapping for every monster (same contract as characters2/animation_map.json). Keys under `states` are the game's logical names and map to the animation folder under monsters/<id>/animations/; `overrides.<id>` wins where a monster deviates — e.g. {"angry": "idle"} means this monster has no angry animation and the game should reuse idle (maintainer rule). `missing` lists states a monster cannot serve at all yet. REGENERATED by monsters/pipeline/sync.py from config/roster.json renames — to change a mapping, edit the roster and re-run sync.
